Author: Charlie1361
Name: XIVibration
Punchline: Controller vibration on every skill, timed to its hits.
Description: Every skill of every job makes your gamepad vibrate, right on its hits. When you use a skill, the plugin reads that skill's animation timeline (the modded one through Penumbra, if you use a mod) and vibrates on the frame where the hit lands. If the MultiHit plugin has a hit table for the skill, each hit gets its own pulse. The vibration goes through the game's own controller function, so it works with every controller the game supports. Animations that already vibrate on their own are left alone, unless you choose to replace them. Skills are grouped by job, and you can switch single skills off or design your own pattern with a timeline editor.
